problem: Harden the append-oriented finalization bootstrap into one portable CAS finalization worker and establish a safe bridge to the legacy frozen registry without duplicate mutation ownership.
root_cause: The Step-1 bootstrap is intentionally workstream-local; wider adoption requires exact legacy-state binding, single-write CAS semantics, and independent readback while legacy mutation remains under its existing authority.
patch: Add a pure finalization worker with injected transport, exact ledger and legacy-registry preconditions, deterministic freeze/manifest/bridge targets, one CAS write, independent readback, and read-only legacy bridge semantics.
